widget_rings.xml:
android:background="@drawable/widget_bg_dark_88">

    <!-- One UI Home expands Samsung's 46dp template arc to ~54dp in a 2x1 host. -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:gravity="center"
    android:background="@drawable/widget_bg_dark_88">

    <!-- One UI Home expands Samsung's 46dp template arc to ~54dp in a 2x1 host. -->
    <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/widget_meter_content"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:gravity="center"
                android:text="@string/widget_sample_primary_value"
                android:textColor="#ff111315"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textSize="14.5sp" />
            <TextView android:id="@+id/primary_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/primary_reset" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
                android:text="@string/widget_sample_primary_value"
                android:textColor="#ff111315"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textSize="14.5sp"  android:maxLines="1" android:autoSizeTextType="uniform" android:autoSizeMinTextSize="9sp" android:autoSizeMaxTextSize="14.5sp"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/primary_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/primary_reset" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
                android:text="@string/widget_sample_secondary_value"
                android:textColor="#ff111315"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textSize="14.5sp" />
            <TextView android:id="@+id/secondary_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/secondary_reset" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
                android:text="@string/widget_sample_secondary_value"
                android:textColor="#ff111315"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textSize="14.5sp"  android:maxLines="1" android:autoSizeTextType="uniform" android:autoSizeMinTextSize="9sp" android:autoSizeMaxTextSize="14.5sp"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/secondary_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/secondary_reset" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        <TextView android:id="@+id/reset_credit_button" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
    </LinearLayout>
    <TextView android:id="@+id/updated_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
</FrameLayout>
        <TextView android:id="@+id/reset_credit_button" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" 
        android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
    </LinearLayout>
    <TextView android:id="@+id/updated_label" android:visibility="gone" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="12dp" android:layout_gravity="bottom" android:gravity="center" android:includeFontPadding="false" android:textSize="9sp" android:maxLines="1" android:ellipsize="end" android:autoSizeTextType="uniform" android:autoSizeMinTextSize="7sp" android:autoSizeMaxTextSize="9sp" android:fontFamily="@font/pretendard_family"/>
</FrameLayout>
